title: Auxiliary Power Unit Air Intake Flap Actuator — Installation

issue.reason: Issue C. Earlier issues are not held in this dataset.

abstract: Installation of the intake flap actuator with the proximity target gap setting and the three-cycle functional check that proves the flap reaches the fully open position and indicates it.

sections.purpose: This task installs the air intake flap actuator, sets the proximity sensing gap and proves the flap travel and the open indication before the compartment is closed.
sections.job_setup_note: Have the removal task record available: the sensing gap depends on which proximity target standard is fitted and the removal record says which one it is. The feeler gauge must be non-magnetic. Do not use a steel gauge at the proximity target; it will give a false gap reading.
sections.procedure: 1. Make sure that the fire extinguishing bottle is still safetied and that the warning notice is in place. 2. Clean the mounting face at the shroud D4910119498267 and remove any dust from the aperture. 3. Lift the actuator into the compartment on the lanyard and engage the output shaft with the flap arm. 4. Fit the anti-rotation slot pin and confirm that it is fully home. 5. Install the anchor nuts AGS522879K5 with the plain washers LN427759-6B under every head and torque them in a diagonal sequence. CAUTION: DO NOT USE THE OLD BARREL NUTS ON A REWORKED SHROUD. THE THREAD ENGAGEMENT IS NOT THE SAME. 6. Connect the actuator connector and lock it. 7. Set the proximity sensing gap at the target on the flap hinge arm with the non-magnetic feeler gauge to the value in the limits table. 8. Remove the flap support prop. 9. Restore power and operate the flap through three full open and close cycles. 10. Record the opening time of each cycle. It must be inside the figure in the limits table at the ambient temperature recorded. 11. Confirm that the open indication appears in each cycle and that it clears on closing. 12. WARNING: KEEP CLEAR OF THE FLAP DURING THE CYCLE TEST. THE ACTUATOR WILL MOVE IT WITHOUT WARNING. 13. Refit the bracket 64PA and the cowl latch 52PB and close the panels.
sections.close_out: Record the sensing gap, the three opening times and the ambient temperature. Remove the fire bottle safety pin, record its number against the removal entry and confirm that the bottle is armed. Remove the warning notice from the flight compartment.

type_data.effectivity_note: All aircraft; the sensing gap value differs between the delivered and the repositioned proximity target

safety_precautions: Keep the fire bottle safetied until the task is complete.
Keep clear of the flap during the cycle test.
